newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, seen rising tomorrow.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, seen rising tomorrow.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Portuguese shares closed higher in line with foreign markets, after an apathetic start to the session. Cement firm Cimpor accounted for 24 percent of the turnover of 8.9 billion escudos as today was the last trading day with the right to receive dividends in the stock. Portugal Telecom traded higher after the share closed stronger on the New York market on Friday. Shares of retail group Sonae Investimentos hit a new high of 6,195 escudos ahead of the release of first quarter results, expected later this week. Dealers noted buying orders after the opening of Wall Street and said the impetus could continue into tomorrow. "Everything will depend on the close of New York, but if this positive mood continues, prices should lift a little more tomorrow," said one operator.
